name: org.radarbase.passive.empatica.E4Service
description: When RADAR-base collection is configured for an Empatica E4 wristband, this service scans for and connects to the band, then collects movement, pulse, blood-volume pulse, skin response, heartbeat intervals, temperature, battery, and device status.
disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop connecting to Empatica E4 wristbands and collecting their sensor readings.
